brands.name: AQUADRAIN
brands.description: High-quality, design-led shower channels and floor drains for domestic, commercial and industrial installations. AQUADRAIN caters to the finer details of design and specification, covering an extensive range of luxury finishes to coordinate with your brassware. Crafted from industrial-grade stainless steel, all products are anti-bacterial, easy to clean and anti-corrosive.

brands.name: AQUAECO
brands.description: Discover AQUAECO's comprehensive collection of durable and reliable washroom solutions that cater to the diverse needs of the commercial and residential sectors. Offering a compelling combination of quality, reliability, and outstanding value, the range includes sanitaryware, touchless taps and dispensers, bidet sprays, valves and flush plates in an array of on-trend finishes.

brands.name: BAGNODESIGN
brands.description: Create luxurious, design-led bathrooms from an extensive range of sanitaryware, furniture, brassware, accessories, bath & shower components and spa solutions. Turning spaces into spa-like sanctuaries, BAGNODESIGN is where comfort meets quality and function meets the latest in artisanal thinking.

brands.name: BYSTRO
brands.description: Designed for how we live, cook and connect. Discover indoor and outdoor kitchen appliances, small appliances and fixtures inspired by Italian design.

brands.name: GYMKHANA
brands.description: Everything you need to create a relaxing outdoor oasis. GYMKHANA brings a comprehensive range of stylish outdoor solutions for luxury lounging, al fresco dining, and relaxing by the pool.

brands.name: RICHMOND
brands.description: Make your guests' stay memorable. RICHMOND is a hand-selected range of hotel amenities designed with luxury, comfort and pampering in mind.

brands.name: Sanaura
brands.description: Derived from the name 'SANIPEX' and 'aura' — meaning light and atmosphere — SANAURA offers luminaires for a range of needs and for every space, indoors and out.

brands.name: Surfaces
brands.description: A collection of the latest trends in many textures, finishes, sizes and formats, SURFACES by BAGNODESIGN offers a unique range of tiles and slabs for indoor and outdoor spaces.

brands.name: URBAN LIFE
brands.description: Emphasising safety, practicality, and convenience, Urban Life provides stylish, contemporary outdoor furniture for public spaces. Crafted from durable materials, the range includes benches, litter bins, planters, bike racks.
